source.title: Miststalker's Wristbands: Midnight S2 item and sampled live-use census
source.author: GamGem Research

notes: NEW independently indexed 272246 equipped-item identity corroboration, NOT disenchant evidence: Blizzard's indexed Stonemaul/Keshtomah character armory displays Miststalker's Wristbands at item level 305 (https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/en-us/worldsoul/us/armory/character/stonemaul/keshtomah/). GamGem's Nov 7 catalog explicitly identifies 206 as Blizzard BASE PREVIEW item level, not the dropped/equipped level; its separately derived Oct27-Nov1 top-key census found item 272246 equipped by 43 of 11,153 sampled characters, which is EQUIPPED prevalence, not a sample of 43 DE operations. Original 272246 itemLink bonus IDs, exact item-level at DE, eligibility, output item-linked material ranks and full complete at-cast receipt remain unverified; WoWDB continues to mark the base item cannot be disenchanted while Wowhead's cumulative Looter records remain unvalidated as independent cohorts. Search engines also returned a third-party simulated 315 variant; do not use it as an at-cast proven item. Other searches yielded only already indexed Cardinalai 237362 800-cast totals, Stormwarning 237365 sample, Honeybone copper, Aug22 staff single DE and Mar14 milling reports, all previously recorded. No new estimator-eligible outcome data.
